what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Afghanistan in Saudi Arabia: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2021, the last year with a figure, UNHCR counted 231 Afghan asylum seekers in Saudi Arabia, 0.1% of all asylum seekers from Afghanistan that year.
Refugees from Afghanistan, a separate group, live mostly in Pakistan, Iran, Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1996 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group runs from 2001, at 43 asylum seekers, to 2021, and fell to a low in 2008.
Its highest and last figure is for 2021, the main year of displacement in the data.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Saudi Arabia.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Saudi Arabia only, reported to UNHCR from 2001 to 2021.
